info.name: Library Management System API
info.description: Enterprise Library Management System (.NET 10). Import this file, select the "Library MS - Local" environment (or keep the baseUrl collection variable = http://localhost:5254), start the API with `dotnet run --project src/Library.Api`, and every request runs as-is. The **Smoke Flow** folder is a runnable end-to-end happy path for the Collection Runner. Failure responses follow RFC 7807 (application/problem+json) with `success`, `errors[]` and `correlationId`.

item.name: Books
item.description: Catalog CRUD, advanced search and Excel bulk import.

request.description: Quick text search + paging. All query params optional. Use **Search books** for advanced filters.
Fetch a single book. 404 if it does not exist.
GitLab-style search: multiple filters (operators eq, neq, contains, notContains, startsWith, endsWith, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, notIn, between), `match` all|any, multi-sort. Enum fields match by name.
Adds a book. `category` and `publisher` are required. Duplicate ISBN -> 409 BOOK_ISBN_DUPLICATE. Validation returns every error at once.

body.raw:
{
  "isbn": "978-0000000001",
  "title": "The Pragmatic Sequel",
  "author": "A. Hunt",
  "publishedYear": 2020,
  "category": "Software Engineering",
  "publisher": "Addison-Wesley",
  "description": "Example book created from Postman."
}

request.description: Replaces all editable fields.

request.description: Soft delete. If copies exist -> 409 BOOK_HAS_DEPENDENT_COPIES unless `force=true` (cascades). If any copy is borrowed -> always 409 BOOK_HAS_BORROWED_COPIES.
Streams the .xlsx template (headers + example rows + instructions sheet).
multipart/form-data, field `file`. All-or-nothing: any invalid/duplicate row rolls back the whole file and every error is returned with row + column + code.

item.name: Book Copies
item.description: Physical copies of a book: CRUD, status changes, search, bulk import.

request.description: Quick search + optional bookId/status filter + paging.
Advanced search; `status` matched by name (Available, Borrowed, Lost, Damaged, Maintenance).
All copies for one book id.
Single copy by id.
Registers a new copy. Duplicate barcode -> 409 BOOK_COPY_BARCODE_DUPLICATE.
Corrects the barcode.
Condition change. Cannot set Borrowed directly; cannot change a borrowed copy.
Soft delete. Blocked while borrowed. With borrow history -> 409 unless `force=true`.
Streams the .xlsx template.
multipart field `file`. All-or-nothing; references books by ISBN.

item.name: Members
item.description: Membership CRUD, lifecycle (suspend/reactivate/renew/deactivate), search, bulk import.

request.description: Quick search + status filter + paging.
Advanced search; `status` matched by name (Active, Inactive, Suspended).
Single member.
Member + borrowing summary (total/active/overdue/last) + history.
Enrols a member (starts Active, one-year term). `phone` and `address` required. Duplicate number or email -> 409 (both errors returned together).
Updates profile fields.
Soft delete. Blocked with an active borrow (409 MEMBER_HAS_ACTIVE_BORROW). With borrow history -> 409 unless `force=true`.
Same action the nightly job performs for overdue borrowers.
Back to Active without recording a renewal.
Clears suspension and extends the term by one year.
Active -> Inactive (manual equivalent of the expiry job).
Streams the .xlsx template.
multipart field `file`. All-or-nothing.

item.name: Borrowing
item.description: Issue and return copies; search borrow records.

request.description: Advanced search; `status` matched by name (Active, Returned, Overdue).
Member must be Active and not expired; copy must be Available. Conflicts return 409.
Closes the borrow record. `returnedAt` optional (defaults to now).

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Aggregated totals for the librarian home screen.

request.description: Catalogue/copy/member/borrowing totals + recent borrows. Served via EF Core or Dapper per `Database:Orm`.

item.name: Jobs
item.description: Manual triggers for scheduled maintenance work.

request.description: Runs the same pass as the midnight job: suspend overdue borrowers + mark expired memberships Inactive. Returns a summary. Gated by the EnableMemberSuspensionCronJob feature flag.

item.name: Smoke Flow (run in order)
item.description: Runnable end-to-end happy path. Use the Collection Runner on this folder: it creates a book, a copy, a member, issues and returns the copy, then cascade-deletes the book. IDs are chained via collection variables.
